$description: Hand-authored DTCG border composites — `{ color, width, style }` triples. Two groups: luminance-based `rise` edges and named `preset` border compositions. Values reference the border/color and border/dimension files via curly-brace syntax.

borderRise.$description: Luminance-based border rise — light edge on dark surface, creates raised appearance.

subtle.$description: Barely visible luminance edge — inputs, secondary containers.

soft.$description: Visible luminance edge — cards, primary containers.

strong.$description: Prominent luminance edge — elevated containers, dialogs.

borderPreset.$description: Named border presets — complete color + width + style compositions for common container treatments.
